data_output.description: data.py continues to return train and validation tuples of (features, labels, users) and a test tuple of (features, users), using exact schema fields and canonical source row order; encoded feature columns remain user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday.

model_input.description: model.py receives an encoded NumPy array with shape (N, 5), columns ordered user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday, and labels only for training steps. The model must retain the existing one-dimensional logits/prediction interface.
